## `simd_bytes::Vec`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L13-L13)

```goose
struct Vec<Lanes> { lanes: Lanes }
```

A byte vector. Supported lane types are u8[16] and u8[32]. Width is a
compile-time type choice, not an instruction-set requirement; use `load<V>`.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::Vec<u8[16]>>("abcdefghijklmnop");
assert(v.eq('p').first() == 15);
```

<a id="api-2"></a>

## `simd_bytes::Mask`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L20-L20)

```goose
struct Mask<Lanes> { lanes: Lanes }
```

Comparison masks contain only 0/255 lanes; do not construct arbitrary masks.

```goose
let mask = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abcdefghijklmnop").eq('b');
assert(mask.to_bits() == 2);
```

## `simd_bytes::U8x16`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L27-L27)

```goose
type U8x16 = Vec<u8[16]>;
```

A 16-byte vector, equivalent to `Vec<u8[16]>`.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abcdefghijklmnop");
assert(v.eq('a').first() == 0);
```

<a id="api-4"></a>

## `simd_bytes::U8x32`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L34-L34)

```goose
type U8x32 = Vec<u8[32]>;
```

A 32-byte vector, equivalent to `Vec<u8[32]>`; may use two 16-byte registers.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x32>("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345");
assert(v.eq('5').last() == 31);
```

## `simd_bytes::load`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L69-L69)

```goose
inline fn load<V>(s: const u8[:]) -> V
```

Read the first vector-width bytes without requiring alignment. V must be
U8x16 or U8x32. Asserts that s contains at least that many bytes.

```goose
let bytes = "_abcdefghijklmnop!";
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>(bytes[1..]);
assert(v.eq('p').first() == 15); // The trailing ! is not loaded.
```

## `simd_bytes::splat`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L79-L79)

```goose
inline fn splat<V>(byte: u8) -> V
```

Fill every lane with byte. V must be U8x16 or U8x32.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::splat<simd_bytes::U8x32>(255);
assert(v.eq(255).to_bits() == 0xFFFFFFFF);
```

## `simd_bytes::eq`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L88-L88)

```goose
inline fn eq<L>(v: Vec<L>, x: u8) -> Mask<L>
```

Compare each byte lane to x, returning 0xff for equal lanes and 0 otherwise.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abacdefghijklmno");
assert(v.eq('a').to_bits() == 5); // Lanes 0 and 2.
assert(v.eq('z').first() == -1);
```

<a id="api-8"></a>

## `simd_bytes::eq`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L97-L97)

```goose
inline fn eq<L>(a: Vec<L>, b: Vec<L>) -> Mask<L>
```

Compare corresponding lanes of two vectors of the same width.
Equal lanes contain 0xff; unequal lanes contain 0.

```goose
let a = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abcdefghijklmnop");
let b = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("aXcXXXXXXXXXXXXp");
assert(a.eq(b).to_bits() == 0x8005);
```

<a id="api-9"></a>

## `simd_bytes::bit_and`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L105-L105)

```goose
inline fn bit_and<L>(a: Mask<L>, b: Mask<L>) -> Mask<L>
```

Keep lanes matched by both masks. The masks must have the same width.

```goose
let a = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abacdefghijklmno").eq('a');
let b = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("xxaxxxxxxxxxxxxx").eq('a');
assert(a.bit_and(b).to_bits() == 4); // Only lane 2.
```

## `simd_bytes::bit_or`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L112-L112)

```goose
inline fn bit_or<L>(a: Mask<L>, b: Mask<L>) -> Mask<L>
```

Keep lanes matched by either mask. The masks must have the same width.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abcdefghijklmnop");
assert(v.eq('a').bit_or(v.eq('d')).to_bits() == 9);
```

## `simd_bytes::bit_not`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L120-L120)

```goose
inline fn bit_not<L>(m: Mask<L>) -> Mask<L>
```

Invert every lane of a comparison mask, exchanging 0 and 0xff.

```goose
let mask = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x16>("abcdefghijklmnop").eq('a');
assert(mask.bit_not().first() == 1);
assert(mask.bit_not().to_bits() == 65534); // Only the low 16 bits.
```

## `simd_bytes::to_bits`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L128-L128)

```goose
inline fn to_bits<L>(m: Mask<L>) -> u32
```

Extract one bit per matched lane. Lane 0 is bit 0; bits above the mask
width are zero. The input must contain only comparison-mask values.

```goose
let v = simd_bytes::load<simd_bytes::U8x32>("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345");
assert(v.eq('5').to_bits() == 0x80000000);
```

## `simd_bytes::load_u16`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L162-L165)

```goose
inline fn load_u16(s: const u8[:]) -> u16
```

Read the first two bytes as a native-endian integer, without alignment
requirements. Asserts s.len >= 2. Not a portable serialization primitive.

```goose

```

## `simd_bytes::find_byte`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L196-L205)

```goose
simd fn find_byte(s: const u8[:], byte: u8) -> i64
```

Return the first byte offset matching byte, or -1 if none exists.
Accepts inputs of any length, including empty slices. Clang/x86 builds
select SIMD at runtime; other backends use their build target or scalar code.

```goose
assert(simd_bytes::find_byte("goose", 's') == 3);
assert(simd_bytes::find_byte("goose", 'x') == -1);
assert(simd_bytes::find_byte("", 'g') == -1);
```

<a id="api-19"></a>

## `simd_bytes::find_pair`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L215-L228)

```goose
simd fn find_pair(s: const u8[:], a: u8, b: u8) -> i64
```

Return the first byte offset of adjacent bytes a, b, or -1 if absent.
Empty and one-byte inputs cannot match. Uses the same whole-loop SIMD
dispatch as find_byte.

```goose
assert(simd_bytes::find_pair("goose", 'o', 's') == 2);
assert(simd_bytes::find_pair("goose", 'g', 's') == -1);
```

<a id="api-20"></a>

## `simd_bytes::decode_nibbles`

[source](simd_bytes.goose#L243-L247)

```goose
fn decode_nibbles(input: const u8[:], output: u8[:], table: const u8[:], low_first: bool) -> bool
```

Expand packed 4-bit indices through a 16-byte table into caller-owned output.
Returns false without writing when input or table is too short. The output
length determines how many nibbles to decode, including an odd last nibble.
Input, table and output must not overlap. low_first selects CRAM ordering;
false selects BAM ordering. Dispatches once per slice, with scalar tails.

```goose
let packed: u8[2] = [0x21, 0x43];
var out: u8[3] = [0; 3];
assert(simd_bytes::decode_nibbles(packed, out, "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", true));
assert(out[0] == 'B' && out[1] == 'C' && out[2] == 'D');
```

## `simd_int::U16x8`

[source](simd_int.goose#L12-L12)

```goose
struct U16x8 { lanes: u16[8] }
```

Eight unsigned 16-bit lanes. Arithmetic wraps modulo 65536; masks use
zero/65535 lanes. Width does not imply a required CPU instruction set.

```goose
let v = simd_int::splat(7);
assert(v.reduce_max() == 7);
```

## `simd_int::load_low_u16`

[source](simd_int.goose#L22-L22)

```goose
inline fn load_low_u16(input: const u32[:]) -> U16x8
```

Load the low 16 bits of eight u32s, discarding their upper halves.
Asserts input.len >= 8; reads exactly eight elements.

```goose
let input: u32[8] = [65537, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8];
assert(simd_int::load_low_u16(input).lanes[0] == 1);
```

[source](simd_int.goose#L61-L61)

```goose
extern fn to_bits(mask: U16x8) -> u32 = "goosimd_int_bits";
```

Extract one bit per mask lane, lane 0 first. Input must contain only

```goose

```

## `simd_int::select`

[source](simd_int.goose#L70-L70)

```goose
extern fn select(mask: U16x8, yes: U16x8, no: U16x8) -> U16x8 = "goosimd_int_select";
```

Select yes on matched mask lanes, no otherwise. Mask lanes must be
zero/65535, such as the result of le().

```goose
let mask = simd_int::splat(1).prefix_sum().le(simd_int::splat(4));
let v = mask.select(simd_int::splat(19), simd_int::splat(23));
assert(v.lanes[3] == 19 && v.lanes[4] == 23);
```

## `simd_int::expand_u32`

[source](simd_int.goose#L108-L113)

```goose
fn expand_u32(input: const u32[:], output: u32[:], mask: u16) -> bool
```

Expand consecutive input values into the set lanes of a 16-bit mask;
unset lanes become zero. Writes exactly 16 output elements. Returns false
without writing if output.len < 16 or input.len < popcount(mask).
Input/output must not overlap; neither requires alignment or extra padding.

```goose
let input: u32[3] = [90000, 17, 4294967295];
var out: u32[16] = [99; 16];
assert(simd_int::expand_u32(input, out, 0x8005));
assert(out[0] == 90000 && out[1] == 0 && out[2] == 17 && out[15] == 4294967295);
```
